name: Psono
description: Psono wires update-electron-app to check the psono/psono-client repository hourly and includes Squirrel startup handling. Its packaging source enables macOS notarization, but the Windows NSIS/portable configuration shown here has no signing control; cross-platform code-sign enforcement remains unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; update-electron-app implementation details are dependency code rather than included application source.
Package configuration does not prove the signing policy of a particular released artifact or platform installer.
